No wonder the skies have been so furious.|[[Borjak]], speaking of [[Feln]]|<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 30">[[Knights of the Old Republic 30|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 30]]</ref>}}
The '''Rime Feeorin''' was the ancient code of the [[Feeorin/Legends|Feeorin]] by the time of the [[Mandalorian Wars]].

The Rime Feeorin is known to have included the rules that -
*No outsider (non-Feeorin) may enter the [[Sanctum of the Exalted]].
*Any person who enters the Sanctum of the Exalted is beyond weapons, and 'cannot be harmed by blade or bludgeon while the Sanctum stands'. As such they can only be fought hand-to-hand.
*The [[Exalted]] is to be obeyed.

[[Feln]], of the [[Jedi Covenant]], was known to break the Rime Feeorin during his time as leader, allowing the Sanctum to be turned into a storehouse for [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]]. After the Sanctum of the Exalted was [[Option Ossus|destroyed]], the strictures of the Rime Feeorin ceased to apply, allowing the Feeorin to [[Death/Legends|kill]] an unarmed Feln with primitive weapons.
